name: Hollow Banner Maw
loreTies: A crawling banner-creature that grew from the Forgotten Standard Bearer’s shadow and devours unit identity.
Drags nearby swarm units into frenzy when a Deity falls below half health.
Erasure is not death; erasure is ownership without memory.
shortBackstory: Hollow Banner Maw is a Hollow threat creature built for campaign and event encounters, turning erased memory into major battlefield pressure.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Hollow Banner Maw formed where the Hollow learned a specific weakness in remembered civilization. It is not a Deity, not a citizen, and not a recruitable unit; it is a symptom of the Gate giving absence a body.

chapters.title: Hollow Function
chapters.text: Its role inside the Hollow threat faction is precise: Drags nearby swarm units into frenzy when a Deity falls below half health. This lets mission designers select it by encounter tags instead of treating Hollow enemies as one shapeless swarm.

chapters.title: Lore Tie
chapters.text: A crawling banner-creature that grew from the Forgotten Standard Bearer’s shadow and devours unit identity.

chapters.title: Campaign Use
chapters.text: Hollow Banner Maw can appear in Normal missions, Elite remixes, Hollow Breach events, Ascension floors, and raid add waves when its tags match the objective pressure. It must always reinforce Hollowing: isolation, corrupted memory, broken objectives, or stolen meaning.

chapters.title: Visual / Encounter Rule
chapters.text: Art and gameplay must keep Hollow Banner Maw visibly non-playable. Its silhouette uses low quadruped made of torn banners, bone pole ribs, mouth hidden under cloth, erased sigils crawling over hide. while its abilities — Devour Insignia, Nameless Rally — create battlefield pressure without confusing it for a faction Deity.

developmentStatus: Readable Hollow creature profile integrated into campaign/event threat pages.
